title: Functions I
subtitle: First Recipes
liveNote: Unit 1 (hello-world) and Unit 2 (control-flow); Unit 2's walkthrough fixes are in this checkout (open PR #15)
siteNote: Unit 3 is the Functions unit: explain.ts already has a FUNCTIONS_UNIT_ORDER-style gate for 'make it with def' advice (unit order >= 3) — reuse it.
reviewFocus: (1) as "starting-from-zero": Lesson 6A from the start — write the class's slips: f(x) = 5x math style (`max_fuel_for(cells) = cells * 5`), `def f("cells"):`, no return (the caller gets None), print inside the recipe instead of return, `return result` after `fuel = ...`, defining a recipe but never calling it, calling before defining, forgetting the () on a call; judge every message and Help rung, especially the blank-start max-fuel recipe; (2) as "right shape, wrong meaning": literal test values instead of parameters (`return 10 * 5` instead of `base_attack * bonus_multiplier` — 7 of 11 students did this), approximate parameter names, the wrong number of values handed over, copying the example's names; and the ledger trace exercise (does it give its answers away?); (3) as "steady with a template": the replace-pass cabin-door recipes and the extra practice twins; (4) as "ready to stretch": take a Quick Check Recipes I form end to end (including the trace task) and the optional Lucky's Supply Run challenge, and judge whether it is an honest fast path.
